integrity: Analytic proof of universal upper bound, sharp two-atom construction, algebraic optimizer and equality rigidity; reproducible checker verifies symbolic reductions and finite numerical stress tests, which do not certify infinite dimensions.
scientific_limitations: Does not cover complex scalars, ambient exponents other than four, or generalized numerator exponents other than two. Equivalence risk remains from inaccessible full text of the 1970 Gastinel–Joly paper or unindexed formulations.
scientific_scope: Real L4 spaces admitting two disjoint measurable sets of finite positive measure; quadratic Gastinel–Joly generalized rectangular constant and all equality cases.
title: Exact quadratic generalized rectangular constant and extremizers of real \(L_4\)
